title: Bench test run (censoring-discipline carrier)
description: Stage contract for one bench run (PRECISION_GREASE_DEV inner loop) and the carrier of the censoring discipline. Provenance of if/then rule (i): real-case evidence -- a right-censored 10 h observation (no event within the 10 h window) must NEVER be recorded or used as event_time = 10 h; once such a value is mixed into an analysis the variance estimate is wrong and every downstream conclusion is void. A right-censored run is therefore recorded as event_occurred=false with event_time=null and a declared stop_reason, never as an end-point value. Rule (ii): any censored observation (RIGHT / LEFT / INTERVAL) must declare why it stopped, so administrative censoring can never be silently presented as a completed run.

allOf.$comment: A right-censored observation is NEVER an end-point value: censoring_type=RIGHT forces event_occurred=false and event_time=null.
A censored observation must declare why it stopped: censoring_type other than NONE requires a non-empty stop_reason.

ctq_reference.description: The CTQ this bench run observed. Step 11 measures the round's CTQ on the bench, and the modeling entry (step 14) links its response references to the CTQs the round's bench runs actually recorded.

protocol_version.description: Frozen bench protocol version this run was executed under.

setpoints.description: Fixed run setpoints recorded as executed (for example load, speed, temperature), one non-empty string each.

raw_record_reference.description: Reference to the immutable raw record this summary is distilled from.

event_occurred.description: Whether the defined event actually occurred inside the observation window. false means the run produced no event (typically censored).

event_time.description: Event time in hours when event_occurred is true; null when no event occurred. A censoring time is NEVER recorded here.

censoring_type.description: Censoring discipline for this observation: NONE (event observed), RIGHT, LEFT or INTERVAL.

stop_reason.description: Why the run stopped. Hard-required and non-empty whenever censoring_type is not NONE (see if/then rule (ii)); may be null only for an uncensored run.

anomalies.description: Observed anomalies during the run. May be empty; an empty list is an explicit 'none observed'.

campaign_iteration.description: Which inner-loop round of the campaign this run belongs to. Strictly positive.
